notes: bench/Ranvier.RowsBench: a keyed factory projection over records with a label signal; each row's factory creates one effect reading the label, and one effect reads Keys and every row untracked. No DOM.

A: core built with RanvierRowsBaseline=true, createProjectionWith. B: default core, createProjectionWithOptions None. C1: createProjectionWithOptions CreateFirst. C2: createProjectionOnce None. C3: createProjectionOnce CreateFirst. .NET Release (net10.0) and Fable under Node with --expose-gc.

Each process runs every operation `warmup` times, then `samplesPerProcess` times, each sample on a fresh graph after a forced GC; its median is the process's value. A round runs one process per variant in rotating order; ratios divide medians of the same round.
